interpretation: Around100–110g internal filling with100g rice is an empirical starting point in these prototypes, not a universal proven grammage or equal finished dimensions.
proposal: Choose desired blank length/cross-section and rice mat footprint/thickness, calibrate each recipe gram quantities and portion units to that formed geometry; account separately for coating, frying and hats. Same formed internal volume at fixed length/rice geometry can require different mass and different loose preforming volume.
not_known: Ingredient and mixture effective packed densities, compressibility and voids
Retained filling mass for all dispensed portions
Finished postfry dimensions/mass and coating uptake
Whether equal dimensions also produce desired flavour, visual distribution and delivery performance
